title: Exam certification
description: The `certification` block of an exam (exams/<group>/<exam>.yaml): the real certification's facts, taken from the provider's official pages and shown on the exam page. The pass score is the exam's own `pass_score`.

type.description: multiple_choice: one correct answer out of several. performance_based: hands-on tasks in a live environment.

questions.description: Questions (or tasks) in the exam; the low end when questions_max is set.

questions_max.description: Optional; the high end when the provider gives a range ("15–20 tasks").

delivery.description: How the exam is taken. Defaults to online_proctored.

retakes.description: Free retakes included with the purchase.

validity_years.description: How long the certification stays valid.

price_usd.description: Exam-only list price in US dollars.

url.description: The provider's page for the certification.
